thread:
Jamie (Sales): Hey team — Acme ready to push the PO but they sent a redlined MSA/DPA and want EFT net-30. They asked for faster signature routing. Can legal + finance weigh in?
Ben (AE): +1 — timeline is end of week if we can accept EFT. main blocker seems to be a liability cap and DPA SCCs.
Maria (Legal): Please drop the redline excerpt here. If liability cap is 3x fees we need rationale from the customer or to propose 1x. Also need to confirm they want SCCs or our standard Addendum.
Acme Purchasing: Hi — attaching the PO and our preferred DPA changes. We can do net-30 EFT (ACH) to the bank listed. PO# 43821. We prefer the liability cap at 3x fees and an audit clause.
Jamie (Sales): attaching files from customer (PO.pdf, MSA_redline.pdf). Quick snippet of the PO: ```PO#: 43821
Total: $120,000/year
Billing: Net 30 EFT to acct ending 1123 (WELLS)
Contact: purchasing@acme.com```
Sofia (Solutions): technical note — they requested a dedicated VPC option in the SOW. We already scoped Dedicated on the quote. Nothing new technically, but Prod onboarding ETA depends on contract sign date.
Maria (Legal): Redline highlights pasted: ```- Section 10 (Liability): limit set to 3x fees; carveouts for willful misconduct removed
- DPA: adds audit rights, stores logs for 7 years, SCCs requested explicitly
- Termination: 15 day cure period instead of 30```
Maria (Legal): Our position: accept SCCs via standard EU Addendum, keep liability cap at 1x fees (or negotiable to 2x for enterprise), retain 30-day cure. Audit rights: restrict to reasonable scope + notice.
Oliver (Finance): EFT ok. Need vendor banking details validated + tax form (W-9) before first invoice. Can the customer provide remit-to and TAX ID? We can accept ACH but prefer payment terms on the PO to match our invoicing (net-30).
Jamie (Sales): @Acme Purchasing can you share W-9 and confirm the remit-to details match their PO bank? They already provided acct ending 1123 — can you send bank name + routing?
Acme Purchasing: sending W-9 and bank info to jamie@redwood.com now. We can confirm remit-to matches PO. We typically do ACH.
Maria (Legal): Proposed response to customer drafted below — please review: ```We can accept SCCs via Redwood's standard DPA addendum. We request revising liability to 1x fees (or 2x for enterprise) and restore 30-day cure. Audit rights should be limited to security-relevant topics with prior notice. Upon agreement we'll prepare a DocuSign envelope combining MSA+DPA+PO.```
Jamie (Sales): LGTM. Can legal prepare the redline that we send back and flag which changes would require exec approval? If they insist on 3x liability we may need AE + CRO signoff.
Ben (AE): If they push 3x cap, we should ask for commercial concession (longer term or higher commit) — flag to sales leadership.
Maria (Legal): I'll mark the liability and audit clause as escalations. Drafting the counter-redline now. Target to send back by EOD.
Procurement Bot: DocuSign envelope created (env_0b9f). Routing: Jamie -> Maria -> Oliver -> Customer legal -> Customer exec. ETA: 24h after acceptance.
Oliver (Finance): Once we get W-9 + bank info and the PO on our system, we can set up invoicing. Note: if they want ACH we require remittance info on file and a PO number on invoices.
Jamie (Sales): Thanks all. Action items: Maria send counter, Oliver validate W-9 when received, I'll confirm routing with customer and push for signature this week. Acme, ping if anything else from your side. :thumbsup:
